Authored x86_64 C fixture for Rust array-index emission.
Built before changes with:
cc -O2 -g -fno-inline -fno-pie -no-pie /tmp/kuna-rust-array-index/native45/array_index.c /tmp/kuna-rust-array-index/native45/array_index_helpers.c -o /tmp/kuna-rust-array-index/native45/array_index_x86_64

The registered native test recompiles complete C reference bodies at O0/O2 and executes complete emitted Rust bodies at both profiles without rewriting them.45 bodies cover valid field and nested loads/stores, signed/unsigned indices and element sizes1/2/4/8, valid array addresses, callback order, constants, and64 shift counts. Full store buffers include untouched guard bytes and initialized padding. Negative nested outer indices stay inside the allocated rows; inner indices stay0..8. One-past array addresses and invalid indices are outside this test.
